description.en: Printix Secure Print sends PDFs from Power PDF to Printix, and you release the job at any printer. One click sends the open document to your default queue; up to five quick targets put queues, print options or colleagues on the ribbon. Print with options sets colour, two-sided printing, copies and paper size and sends several PDFs at once. My print jobs shows and deletes the jobs this PC sent.
description.de: Printix Secure Print sendet PDFs aus Power PDF an Printix, und Sie geben den Druckjob an jedem Drucker frei. Ein Klick sendet das aktuelle Dokument an Ihre Standard-Warteschlange, und bis zu fünf Quick-Ziele legen Warteschlangen, Druckoptionen oder Kollegen ins Menüband. Drucken mit Optionen legt Farbe, beidseitigen Druck, Kopien und Papierformat fest und sendet mehrere PDFs auf einmal. Meine Druckjobs zeigt und löscht die gesendeten Jobs.
description.fr: Printix Secure Print envoie des PDF de Power PDF vers Printix, et vous libérez le travail sur n’importe quelle imprimante. Un clic envoie le document ouvert vers votre file par défaut ; jusqu’à cinq destinations rapides placent des files, des options d’impression ou des collègues dans le ruban. Imprimer avec options règle la couleur, le recto verso, le nombre de copies et le format de papier, et envoie plusieurs PDF à la fois. Mes travaux d’impression affiche et supprime les travaux envoyés depuis ce PC.
description.it: Printix Secure Print invia i PDF da Power PDF a Printix, e tu rilasci il lavoro su qualsiasi stampante. Un clic invia il documento aperto alla tua coda predefinita; fino a cinque destinazioni rapide portano code, opzioni di stampa o colleghi sulla barra multifunzione. Stampa con opzioni imposta colore, fronte-retro, copie e formato carta e invia più PDF in una volta. I miei lavori di stampa mostra ed elimina i lavori inviati da questo PC.
description.es: Printix Secure Print envía PDF desde Power PDF a Printix, y usted libera el trabajo en cualquier impresora. Un clic envía el documento abierto a su cola predeterminada; hasta cinco destinos rápidos colocan colas, opciones de impresión o compañeros en la cinta. Imprimir con opciones ajusta el color, la impresión a doble cara, las copias y el tamaño de papel, y envía varios PDF a la vez. Mis trabajos de impresión muestra y elimina los trabajos enviados desde este PC.
description.nl: Printix Secure Print stuurt pdf's vanuit Power PDF naar Printix, en je geeft de taak vrij op elke printer. Eén klik stuurt het geopende document naar je standaardwachtrij; tot vijf snelle doelen zetten wachtrijen, afdrukopties of collega's op het lint. Afdrukken met opties stelt kleur, dubbelzijdig afdrukken, exemplaren en papierformaat in en verstuurt meerdere pdf's tegelijk. Mijn afdruktaken toont en verwijdert de taken die deze pc heeft verstuurd.
description.pt: O Printix Secure Print envia PDFs do Power PDF para o Printix, e você libera o trabalho em qualquer impressora. Um clique envia o documento aberto para sua fila padrão; até cinco destinos rápidos colocam filas, opções de impressão ou colegas na faixa de opções. Imprimir com opções define cor, impressão frente e verso, cópias e tamanho do papel e envia vários PDFs de uma vez. Meus trabalhos de impressão mostra e exclui os trabalhos enviados deste PC.
description.da: Printix Secure Print sender PDF'er fra Power PDF til Printix, og du frigiver jobbet på en hvilken som helst printer. Et klik sender det åbne dokument til din standardkø; op til fem hurtigmål lægger køer, udskriftsindstillinger eller kolleger på båndet. Udskriv med indstillinger vælger farve, dobbeltsidet udskrivning, kopier og papirformat og sender flere PDF'er på én gang. Mine udskriftsjob viser og sletter de job, som denne pc har sendt.
description.fi: Printix Secure Print lähettää PDF-tiedostot Power PDF:stä Printixiin, ja vapautat työn millä tahansa tulostimella. Yksi napsautus lähettää avoimen asiakirjan oletusjonoosi; enintään viisi pikakohdetta tuo jonoja, tulostusasetuksia tai kollegoita valintanauhaan. Tulosta asetuksilla määrittää värin, kaksipuolisen tulostuksen, kopiot ja paperikoon ja lähettää useita PDF-tiedostoja kerralla. Omat tulostustyöt näyttää ja poistaa tämän tietokoneen lähettämät työt.
description.nb: Printix Secure Print sender PDF-er fra Power PDF til Printix, og du frigir jobben på hvilken som helst skriver. Ett klikk sender det åpne dokumentet til standardkøen din; opptil fem hurtigmål legger køer, utskriftsalternativer eller kolleger på båndet. Skriv ut med alternativer stiller inn farge, tosidig utskrift, kopier og papirstørrelse og sender flere PDF-er samtidig. Mine utskriftsjobber viser og sletter jobbene denne PC-en har sendt.
description.sv: Printix Secure Print skickar PDF-filer från Power PDF till Printix, och du släpper jobbet på valfri skrivare. Ett klick skickar det öppna dokumentet till din standardkö; upp till fem snabbmål lägger köer, utskriftsalternativ eller kolleger i menyfliksområdet. Skriv ut med alternativ ställer in färg, dubbelsidig utskrift, kopior och pappersstorlek och skickar flera PDF-filer på en gång. Mina utskriftsjobb visar och tar bort jobben som den här datorn har skickat.
description.pl: Printix Secure Print wysyła pliki PDF z Power PDF do Printix, a zadanie zwalniasz na dowolnej drukarce. Jedno kliknięcie wysyła otwarty dokument do Twojej domyślnej kolejki; do pięciu szybkich miejsc docelowych umieszcza kolejki, opcje drukowania lub współpracowników na wstążce. Drukuj z opcjami ustawia kolor, druk dwustronny, liczbę kopii i rozmiar papieru oraz wysyła wiele plików PDF naraz. Moje zadania drukowania pokazuje i usuwa zadania wysłane z tego komputera.
description.cs: Printix Secure Print odesílá soubory PDF z Power PDF do Printix a úlohu uvolníte na libovolné tiskárně. Jedno kliknutí odešle otevřený dokument do vaší výchozí fronty; až pět rychlých cílů umístí fronty, možnosti tisku nebo kolegy na pás karet. „Tisk s možnostmi“ nastaví barvu, oboustranný tisk, počet kopií a velikost papíru a odešle více souborů PDF najednou. „Moje tiskové úlohy“ zobrazí a odstraní úlohy odeslané z tohoto počítače.
description.hu: A Printix Secure Print a Power PDF-ből küldi a PDF-eket a Printixbe, a feladatot pedig bármelyik nyomtatón kiadhatja. Egy kattintás az alapértelmezett sorba küldi a megnyitott dokumentumot; legfeljebb öt gyorscél helyez sorokat, nyomtatási beállításokat vagy kollégákat a menüszalagra. A „Nyomtatás beállításokkal” megadja a színt, a kétoldalas nyomtatást, a példányszámot és a papírméretet, és egyszerre több PDF-et küld. A „Nyomtatási feladataim” megmutatja és törli az erről a gépről küldött feladatokat.
description.ru: Printix Secure Print отправляет PDF из Power PDF в Printix, а задание вы выпускаете на любом принтере. Один щелчок отправляет открытый документ в вашу очередь по умолчанию; до пяти быстрых адресатов размещают очереди, параметры печати или коллег на ленте. «Печать с параметрами» задает цвет, двустороннюю печать, число копий и размер бумаги и отправляет несколько PDF сразу. «Мои задания печати» показывает и удаляет задания, отправленные с этого компьютера.
description.tr: Printix Secure Print, PDF'leri Power PDF'ten Printix'e gönderir ve işi istediğiniz yazıcıda serbest bırakırsınız. Bir tıklama açık belgeyi varsayılan kuyruğunuza gönderir; en fazla beş hızlı hedef kuyrukları, yazdırma seçeneklerini veya iş arkadaşlarını şeride yerleştirir. “Seçeneklerle yazdır” rengi, çift taraflı yazdırmayı, kopya sayısını ve kağıt boyutunu ayarlar ve birden çok PDF'i aynı anda gönderir. “Yazdırma işlerim” bu bilgisayarın gönderdiği işleri gösterir ve siler.
description.zh-Hans: Printix Secure Print 将 PDF 从 Power PDF 发送到 Printix，您可以在任意打印机上释放作业。单击一次即可将打开的文档发送到您的默认队列；最多五个快捷目标可将队列、打印选项或同事放到功能区上。“带选项打印”可设置颜色、双面打印、份数和纸张大小，并可一次发送多个 PDF。“我的打印作业”显示并删除此电脑发送的作业。
description.zh-Hant: Printix Secure Print 會將 PDF 從 Power PDF 傳送到 Printix，您可以在任一台印表機上釋放工作。按一下即可將開啟的文件傳送到您的預設佇列；最多五個快速目標可將佇列、列印選項或同事放到功能區上。「使用選項列印」可設定色彩、雙面列印、份數和紙張大小，並可一次傳送多個 PDF。「我的列印工作」會顯示並刪除這台電腦傳送的工作。
description.ja: Printix Secure Print は、Power PDF から PDF を Printix に送信し、ジョブは任意のプリンターでリリースします。1 回のクリックで開いている文書を既定のキューに送信でき、最大 5 件のクイック送信先でキュー、印刷オプション、同僚をリボンに配置できます。「オプションを指定して印刷」では、カラー、両面印刷、部数、用紙サイズを設定し、複数の PDF を一度に送信できます。「自分の印刷ジョブ」では、この PC から送信したジョブを表示して削除できます。
description.ko: Printix Secure Print는 Power PDF에서 PDF를 Printix로 보내고, 작업은 아무 프린터에서나 릴리스합니다. 클릭 한 번으로 열려 있는 문서를 기본 대기열로 보내며, 최대 다섯 개의 빠른 대상으로 대기열, 인쇄 옵션 또는 동료를 리본에 놓을 수 있습니다. “옵션을 지정하여 인쇄”에서는 색, 양면 인쇄, 매수, 용지 크기를 설정하고 여러 PDF를 한 번에 보냅니다. “내 인쇄 작업”에서는 이 PC가 보낸 작업을 보고 삭제할 수 있습니다.
description.ar: يرسل Printix Secure Print ملفات PDF من Power PDF إلى Printix، وتُطلق أنت المهمة على أي طابعة. ترسل نقرة واحدة المستند المفتوح إلى قائمة الانتظار الافتراضية؛ وتضع حتى خمس وجهات سريعة قوائم الانتظار أو خيارات الطباعة أو الزملاء على الشريط. تتيح «الطباعة مع خيارات» ضبط اللون والطباعة على الوجهين وعدد النسخ وحجم الورق وإرسال عدة ملفات PDF دفعة واحدة. تعرض «مهام الطباعة الخاصة بي» المهام التي أرسلها هذا الكمبيوتر وتحذفها.

changelog.it: Guida: i capitoli non mostrano più numeri e i rimandi ad altri capitoli sono link che portano direttamente lì.
changelog.es: Ayuda: los capítulos ya no muestran números y las referencias a otros capítulos son enlaces que llevan directamente a ellos.

changelog.ko: 도움말: 장에 더 이상 번호가 표시되지 않으며 다른 장에 대한 참조는 해당 장으로 바로 이동하는 링크입니다.
changelog.ar: التعليمات: لم تعد الفصول تعرض أرقامًا، وأصبحت الإحالات إلى فصول أخرى روابط تنقلك إليها مباشرة.

complianceAudit.method: Checked every #include and linker input of the store project (Windows SDK, MFC/ATL, CryptoAPI, CNG (bcrypt) and the Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK), the bundled UILayout, assets and LICENSES.md (the catalog icon and the ribbon bitmaps are drawn from the Printix mark of Tungsten's own Printix logo by store/make_px_icons.py), copied code, secrets and personal data (none in the package; the only contact data is the support address in author/contactEmail, shown in the catalog on purpose), and all network code. One MIT library (nlohmann/json); json.hpp contains code by other authors (MIT, CC0-1.0 for Hedley, an unchanged Apache-2.0 excerpt of Google Abseil), all license texts in LICENSES.md. Since 1.2.0 the windows Settings, Print with options and My print jobs are local pages of the Tungsten Plug-in UI (own code, MIT) in WebView2 (Microsoft WebView2 SDK, BSD-3-Clause; the Edge WebView2 Runtime is part of Windows); the pages are inlined into the plug-in, may not navigate, open windows, download or ask for permissions, and talk to the plug-in only through JSON messages. The Printix client secret is entered by the user or admin and stored DPAPI-protected, never in the package. Setup codes (optional) carry a connection to other devices, encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key derived (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 120000 rounds, random salt) from a random password that is generated with the code and handed over separately; no key or secret is built into the plug-in or its tools. Personal data kept on the PC: 'My print jobs' keeps the ids of the jobs this PC sent in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Tungsten\PrintixSecurePrint\jobs.json (document title, queue, recipient e-mail, time; at most 100 entries / 30 days; policy JobHistory=0 switches it off) and asks Printix only for those jobs; quick targets may hold colleagues' e-mail addresses (HKCU; policy SendToOthers=0 switches printing for others off). The host learn.microsoft.com appears only in comments of the Microsoft WebView2 SDK headers in the source ZIP; the plug-in never contacts it. Since 1.2.3 the field 'For' searches the Printix users (names and e-mail addresses from the tenant's own Printix, shown in the window and not stored; policy UserDirectory=0 switches it off), jobs for colleagues carry the sender's e-mail in the job title, and the own e-mail is the Power PDF sign-in (no free entry unless IT allows it). 1.2.4 (audit Oct 13, 2026): the plug-in talks only https, and the access token is only ever sent to api.printix.net; the PDF itself goes to the upload link Printix hands out per job, which is Microsoft Azure Blob Storage (printixapi.blob.core.windows.net), without the token. The support log %TEMP%\PrintixSecurePrint.log keeps no e-mail addresses, document titles, file names, URL queries or tokens (answers only when Printix refuses a request), is capped at about 1 MB (one older generation .old). Unsaved documents are sent from a short-lived copy in %TEMP%\PrintixSecurePrint\{GUID} that is deleted after sending (leftovers after one day). Copying a setup code or its password marks the clipboard entry so Windows keeps it out of the clipboard history and the cloud clipboard. Like any application with client credentials, the plug-in needs the client secret in memory on the PC while it signs in to Printix; the copy is wiped afterwards, and no server is involved. A setup code deployed by policy is protected like other IT policies. The fixed DPAPI entropy of earlier versions was removed (it was no key). Tenant ID, client ID and secret are shown masked in the user interface. Since 1.3.0 the pages also embed the font Red Hat Display 1.023 (SIL OFL 1.1, which allows embedding; inlined at build time, license text in LICENSES.md) and the Tungsten Automation logo 2026 (original SVG from the Tungsten Automation Brand Book, property of Tungsten Automation). 1.4.0: docs/help holds the add-on's own help as HTML (help.json + en/de/fr/it/es/nl.html, generated at build time from the own sources printix/docs/manual/*.src.html by printix/docs/manual/make_help.py; no scripts, no styles, no images, no third-party content). The Help button and F1 of every window call the central help of the Add-on Store client through its HFT TungstenAddonHelp (own interface, common/addonhelp.h and common/addonhelp_client.h) with the fixed add-on id from the code and a topic checked against [a-z0-9-] (max. 64); without it the add-on opens its own docs/help/<lang>.html (lang cut to two letters a-z, else en) with ShellExecuteW and the fixed verb "open" (CWE-78: fixed file name in the add-on's own folder, no command line, no path from the page). 1.4.1: only the help changed (docs/help regenerated by the same own make_help.py: no chapter numbers in headings, references to chapters are links inside the same document, a small style block for the browser view; no scripts, no images).

externalServices.name: Printix Cloud Print API
externalServices.data: the PDF print job (document name, print options), the e-mail address of the user or of the chosen recipients (job owner), the configured tenant and queue; status queries and deletion of the jobs this PC sent; user search for 'For' (query text, answers with names and e-mail addresses)

externalServices.name: Printix authentication
externalServices.data: OAuth client credentials configured by the admin (client ID and secret) to obtain an access token

externalServices.name: Printix upload storage (Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, link handed out by the Cloud Print API per job)
externalServices.data: the bytes of the PDF, uploaded once to the signed storage link Printix returns for the job (no access token)

providers.name: Microsoft Azure Blob Storage (Printix upload storage)
